d: India experienced an episode of high food inflation last during July 2023 to December 2024, when it averaged over 8.5% year-on-year. That was courtesy of a “strong” El Niño, which formed around June 2023 and ended by April 2024. The current El Niño, officially confirmed from June 2026, has already developed into a “very strong” event. Most global weather agencies project it to persist in a “strong-to-very strong” form through January-March, before turning “moderate-to-weak” towards April-May 2027.
